# MOKI Canvas for DSH
简体中文 · Install with DSH · Import formats · Download · DSH plugin community
**A local-first canvas for thinking, creating, and working with DeepSeek Harness.**
MOKI Canvas brings an editable infinite canvas into DSH's side workspace. Sketch an idea, grow it in
to a mind map, collect references, and keep notes, images, files, audio, and video together. The com
pact interface follows DSH's light or dark theme and leaves more room for your work.
Work with DSH in both directions: let the agent read and edit your boards, or select something on th
e canvas and click **Add to chat** beside the composer. Your selection becomes a text reference and
an image attachment in the current draft. You decide when to send it. A six-page, fully editable int
roduction board lets you explore the tools through a playful camping-film project.
## See it in action
These are real, dark-theme DSH interface captures from a separate demo profile containing only the b
undled introduction. The sidebar entry, conversation composer and side workspace stay visible, so yo
u can see how the plugin works inside DSH. No personal boards, accounts, chat history, or local path
s are included. The visible prompts are unsent demonstration drafts.
**1. Open a canvas beside your conversation.**
**2. Select content on the right. A selection hint appears beside the DSH composer.**
**3. Click Add to chat. The text reference and screenshot join your draft; your typed request is pre
k Add to chat. The text reference and screenshot join your draft; your typed request is preserved.**
**4. Edit the canvas directly, or prepare a request for DSH. Here, a mind-map node is selected and i
ts width is adjusted.**
More interactions inside DSH: drawing, materials, previews and page navigation
## What you can do
- **Draw and arrange:** sticky notes, text, shapes, arrows, freehand strokes, Bézier paths, alignmen

t, grouping, zoom, and a minimap.
- **Build real mind maps:** edit node text and width, drag branche
s, collapse or expand them, and add nodes with Tab or Enter. DSH can add up to 200 nodes in one batc

h while preserving hierarchy.
- **Keep references nearby:** add images, files, links, audio, and vid

eo; search, locate, rename, and preview items from the page's materials list.
- **Organize a project
:** multiple pages and page groups, editable boards, version history, `.moki` import/export, and ima

ge export.
- **Collaborate with DSH:** canvas tools register automatically. Ask the agent to inspect

, create, update, arrange, or export content without setting up a separate MCP server.
- **Share a s
election deliberately:** a composer hint previews the active selection; clicking adds its text and s

creenshot to the draft, preserving what you have typed. It does not send a message automatically.
-
**Learn by editing:** the bundled introduction contains six pages, native mind-map nodes, an expanda
ble materials group, and small offline media examples.
## Supported imports
Drop files onto the canvas, paste images or URLs, or add materials from the toolbar. The following d
escribes importing and previewing in **DSH plugin v1.5.2**:
| Type | Formats | Behavior in the canvas |
| Images | PNG, JPG / JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, BMP, SVG | Place, move, resize, and view images on the

canvas |
| Video | MP4, WebM, M4V, MOV, OGV, MKV, AVI | Recognized as video cards; playback depends

on DSH's embedded browser and the file's codecs |
| Audio | MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, OGA, Opus, FLAC

| Drop as audio cards; playback also depends on browser codec support |
| PDF | `.pdf` | Stored as

file cards, with paginated previews in the materials dialog |
| Text and code | `.txt`, `.md`, `.mar
kdown`, `.json`, `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.log`, `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.xml`, `.css`, `.js`, `.ts`, `.py` | Plai

n-text preview in the materials dialog, up to 5 MB |
| Office and other attachments | DOC / DOCX, XL
S / XLSX, PPT / PPTX, ZIP, RAR, 7Z, and other files | Stored as file cards; use Open to access the o

riginal file. These formats currently have no inline preview in the DSH materials dialog |
| Web and
image links | HTTP / HTTPS URLs and direct image URLs | Paste as link cards or images; embedded web

previews depend on the destination site's embedding policy |
| MOKI board files | `.moki`, `.moki-b
oard`, `.moki.json`, `.moki-board.json` | Use Open board file or drag and drop to import editable bo
.json`, `.moki-board.json` | Use Open board file or drag and drop to import editable board content |
Markdown, JSON, CSV, and TSV files are shown as source text in the current DSH materials dialog. Ord
inary `.json` files are text attachments; MOKI board documents use the dedicated board importer.
## Install
Tested with **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 on Windows x64**. Other operating systems and DSH versions
have not been verified for this release. The canvas UI and built-in tour are primarily Chinese; the
plugin's DSH entry and selection controls also provide English labels.

This uses the plugin manager in your current DSH environment. If the tool is unavailable, use a pres
et with plugin management enabled, such as Creator, or enter the same package URL on the sidebar's P
lugins page. Check the reported version, enabled state, and any restart instruction. See the DSH plu
gin-manager reference.
### Manual installation

1. Download `dsh-moki-canvas-1.5.2.tgz` from Releases.
2. For Desktop, use **Manage dsh Command…** i
n the application menu to install or repair the bundled command. Open a new terminal and run `dsh --
version` to confirm it matches Desktop. Then fully quit DSH from its application or tray menu; closi

ng the window may leave it running.
